title_en: Exploratory X3: error falls as a power law with a floor, and the exponent follows the Zipf slope
title_zh: 探索性 X3：误差按带下限的幂律下降，且指数与齐普夫斜率同序
reading_en: Rank correlation between the NDCG@100 error exponent and the Zipf slope is 0.54 at k=all (n=11 datasets) and 0.76 at k=5 (n=11); the prediction was above 0.6. n is small, so these correlations are noisy.
reading_zh: NDCG@100 误差指数与齐普夫斜率的等级相关：k=all 为 0.54（11 个数据集），k=5 为 0.76（11 个）；预测值是高于 0.6。数据集数量少，相关系数噪声大。
rule: Rank correlation of the power-law exponent and the Zipf slope above 0.6 across the datasets (judged on NDCG@100 error, k=all and k=5; needs >= 5 converged datasets)

title_en: Exploratory X4: the Dyer-Owen bound is conservative
title_zh: 探索性 X4：Dyer-Owen 界是保守的
reading_en: The observed number of correctly ordered top items is not stored in the e1 rows, so the rule as written cannot be tested. Only a proxy is reported: the predicted resolve-N beside the N where top-10 overlap first reaches 0.8 (k=all). Top-10 overlap reached 0.8 within the sampled N in 10 of 11 datasets, while the bound predicts 15,535 to 21,065,359 people to settle the top-10; proxy outcome: 9 not contradicted, 0 exceeding, 0 uninformative.
reading_zh: e1 数据中没有保存“实际排对的前几名数量”，因此该规则无法按原文检验。这里只给出代理指标：预测的“排清所需 N”与前 10 名重合度首次达到 0.8 的 N（k=all）。在已抽样的 N 范围内，11 个数据集中有 10 个的前 10 名重合度达到 0.8；而该界预测需要 15,535 到 21,065,359 人才能排清前 10 名；代理结果：9 个未被推翻，0 个超出预测，0 个无法判断。
rule: Observed correctly ordered depth >= the Dyer-Owen bound at every N (cannot be read from e1 rows; proxy only)

title_en: Exploratory X10: the drift between Truth A and Truth B is larger than the sampling error
title_zh: 探索性 X10：真相 A 与真相 B 之间的漂移大于抽样误差
reading_en: On the panel score, the drift gap is larger than the sampling gap at N=1000 in 10/10 datasets (median drift 0.021 vs sampling 0.000); on NDCG@100 against the truth lists it is 10/10 (median drift 0.658 vs sampling 0.003). At the largest N the counts are 10/11 and 11/11.
reading_zh: 按面板得分，在 N=1000 时漂移差距大于抽样差距的数据集为 10/10（漂移中位数 0.021，抽样中位数 0.000）；按对真相榜单的 NDCG@100 为 10/10（漂移中位数 0.658，抽样中位数 0.003）。在最大 N 处分别为 10/11 和 11/11。
rule: Drift gap (Truth A vs Truth B oracle lists) exceeds the sampling gap in most datasets (judged at N=1000, k=all; measures: panel NDCG@100 and NDCG@100 vs the truth lists)
